    spatialTrace a X0 ρ0 u 0 = 3 * P a X0 ρ0 (u ^ 2 / 2) ∧
    rho a X0 ρ0 X0 = ρ0 ∧ P a X0 ρ0 X0 = -ρ0

    (hw : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, 0 ≤ w z) (hiw : Integrable w μ)
    (hiq : Integrable (fun z => w z * chargeOfClock a X0 (u z)) μ)
    (hie : Integrable (fun z => w z * energyOfClock a X0 ρ0 (u z)) μ)
    (hQ : (∫ z, w z * chargeOfClock a X0 (u z) ∂μ) =
      chargeOfClock a X0 v * (∫ z, w z ∂μ)) :
    energyOfClock a X0 ρ0 v * (∫ z, w z ∂μ) ≤
      ∫ z, w z * energyOfClock a X0 ρ0 (u z) ∂μ
